breakage: the init door needs rw_mpas_geometry speaking hex-vertical-v1 and the stream I/O needs rw_mpas_stream; no released gpuwm carries either (the frozen 2.9.0 bridge lacks hex-vertical-v1), so a clean install refused both doors (release readiness B5). The point door needs an rw_mpas_static whose generated-grid statics hold the binary64 coordinates they declare; gpuwm 2.9.0's reads every grid through binary32, so no 3 km regional mesh could be built (ARWEN-VS-HEX-TIMING-2026-10-15). The RRFS fork dycore calls rw_mpas_rrfs_connectivity, rw_mpas_rrfs_damping and rw_mpas_rrfs_deformation, which no released gpuwm carries, so a clean install refused every RRFS forecast ("Rust bridge is not installed"; RRFS-MPAS from a pip install, 2026-10-15). The global door's native static voted the staged 21-category lakes archive, and every MPAS suite on a global row stopped at Noah's first call ("too many input landuse types"). Native-identical lateral boundaries need the case-9 port of rw_mpas_lbc (gpuwm i7, e72f3809); no released gpuwm carries it, and gpuwm 2.9.0's rw_mpas_lbc refuses a regional grid with no model_name attribute and was never proven against native case 9, so a plain install could not build native-identical boundary files (hex 0.4.0 install audit, 2026-10-15). gpuwm-hex score reads the radiosondes of a case NOMADS no longer serves (older than about two days) through rw_igra2, and the published gpuwm 2.9.0 wheel does not install it, so on a plain install every past case scored no sondes ("rw_igra2 is missing from the engine's Rust bridge installation", daily hex rehearsal HX7, 2026-10-15). The mesh generator rebuilt its whole spherical Delaunay on one CPU thread about 1,000 times per graded mesh (123 s on the 1 km-core spec while the card idled), and the serial rw_mpas_geometry held the init door on one thread for minutes (2026-10-16: no single-threaded stages); both now come from gpuwm 3313936ffb2. The point door's halo route cut its native static against the cut grid slot for slot, padding included, and refused every generated point mesh ("provenance grid cellsOnCell differs from the regional cut", unified-image check 2026-10-16); rw_mpas_mesh comes from gpuwm 993858e1744.

rw_mpas_stream.holds: The ordered metadata response required by restart_v842.py preserves native dimension and attribute ordering; a history frame encodes on every core (gpuwm 9060447d1c, G1 output path, same bytes). Built from the gpuwm 2.9.7 public source in the pinned manylinux image with the recorded Rust toolchain and static NetCDF dependencies. Since engine-bridges-v0.4.10: a history frame is written without netCDF-C pre-fill, through 8 MiB buffers, with variables prepared side by side (gpuwm 7c695f68fc, same bytes, about 4x faster), and a write request member compression={level,threads} writes the file as lossless NETCDF4_CLASSIC (shuffle + deflate on every core, gpuwm 106f306593); a request without it writes the deck's container as before. Since the dd8c2e697c re-pin: a scalar variable (MPAS history isice_lu, iswater_lu) carries no _Netcdf4Coordinates attribute, which netCDF-C never writes on a scalar and refused to open ("NetCDF: HDF error" from ncdump 4.9.3 and netCDF4-python on every lossless MPAS-route history frame); every other attribute, dataset and stored chunk byte is unchanged (gpuwm dd8c2e697c).

rw_mpas_static.holds: a generated grid's static stores the binary64 coordinates it declares (Mesh::read_as); a native-init static counts the staged lakes archive's lake pixels (islake) as water before the category vote, as native's 20-category archive holds them, so MPAS Noah's 20-row table accepts it (x1.40962: all 69 variables equal to a static built from modis_landuse_20class_30s); a global mesh's tile maps walk the cell graph from the previous pixel's cell with the kd search as the authority (gpuwm 5033799705 on v2.9.7): byte-identical statics, about twice as fast (16 threads: Vance storm-following start mesh fa1c7bc9 64.9 -> 24.9 s, x1.40962 be5ecb1e 62.6 -> 28.7 s, 240/60 km VR globe bb8f2477 70.9 -> 36.2 s)

rw_mpas_mesh.holds: triangulation kept by Lawson repair and surgery edits, parallel region hull builds, parallel derive; rings start at their smallest neighbour, so --triangulation incremental (default) and rebuild write the same bytes on any thread count; --cull-provenance-grid compares each ring's active slots, not its padding (gpuwm 993858e1744 on lane/292-mesh-parallel 3313936ffb2): a native static zeroes the slots past nEdgesOnCell and a grid repeats the last neighbour, so mesh-plan --point --generate refused the cut of its own halo static (unified-image check 2026-10-16); hex shapes study fixes (gpuwm fix/hex-shapes c3af564a53 on integrate/2.9.5, 2026-10-23): the steepness probes and the shell filter on every core (gpuwm e6d1c8260c; the 993858e1744 bridge sized a polygon on one thread, 40 to 126 s), a drain that leaves a stubborn surgery site is drained once more at the ship floor (a 100-vertex ellipse VR spec was refused), a binary32 provenance word matches under native init_atmosphere's f32(x)*f32(R) as well as f32(x*R), and --cull-mark-parent marks a static's cut on its grid (an NCAR native static could not be cut with its own grid); graded plateau top-up (gpuwm fix/graded-plateau-topup f14ffd8638, merged with c3af564a53 as 3c41c9c551, 2026-10-24): each refinement level reads what its plateau is owed on the parent (the interior parent cells' Voronoi areas), reserves it from the level count and tops the doubled plateau up by it, so a refined core holds its requested spacing (a 1 km core of 150 km on the 64 km ladder delivered 1.029 km and the same core at 300 km was refused at level 6, median 1.0209 against 1.0201; now 1.0081 and 1.0057); a mesh whose plateaus owe nothing keeps its geometry exactly (the 60 -> 15 and 80 -> 5 km zoom globes), only its receipt attribute changes
